Menubar or CLI. [](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vitaliyhayda/claudetransplant/main/menubar.gif) What it does Claude Desktop lists each Claude Code session under the account and organization that created it. Switch accounts and the history stays behind. Moves local Desktop session records to another account. Transcripts and sidecars stay on disk, sessions keep their ids, nothing is copied. Sessions owned by a running Desktop worker are held until you approve a restart, or skipped with Move only the rest. cloud reconciles Remote Control for the signedin source. No model runs, no artifact is recreated. undo reverses the whole move. macOS only. Unofficial, not affiliated with Anthropic. Install Node 22 or newer. The menubar also needs the Xcode command line tools: xcodeselect install npx claudetransplant menubar install the menubar app npx claudetransplant CLI From this repo instead of npm: npx github:vitaliyhayda/claudetransplant (append a tag or commit hash to pin). Menubar Two columns: FROM on the left, TO on the right. Uncheck accounts to leave behind. When the active account is known, TO defaults to the most recently used other account and every other account starts as a source. Otherwise pick TO yourself. Open local sessions offer Stop and restart. Finish move continues the same receipt. Keep completed cancels remaining work without reversing completed moves. Held local work retries when its workers stop. Pending cloud sources retry when that account signs in. Starts at login, shows progress in the icon, notifies when done. Bundles its own CLI, so rerun menubar after upgrading. menubar snapshot panel.png renders the live panel, menubar remove uninstalls, demo <dir renders the animation above. CLI From ↑↓ move · space select · enter next ❯ ◉ you@work.com · Acme Inc. 161 2h ago acmeapi active ◉ you@work.com · Personal 157 1d ago acmeapi ○ you@home.com · Personal 3 5d ago notes ○ you@work2.com · Northwind 12 4m ago northwind To ↑↓ move · enter confirm ❯ ● you@home.com · Personal 3 5d ago notes inventory 318 records 3 already there 307 to move move 308 ✓ 307 zerocopy 1 rescued verify transcripts unchanged ✓ sidecars unchanged ✓ desktop ✓ receipt ~/Library/Application Support/claudetransplant/20260902T160411208.json undo npx claudetransplant undo Command Effect claudetransplant pick From and To, move, print a receipt \dryrun plan only, write nothing undo quarantine the last move and restore
items.author: vhayda
items.descZh: claudetransplant 是一款专为 macOS 设计的开源工具，旨在解决 Claude Desktop 在切换账户后历史会话记录无法跟随的问题。它可以将本地的 Claude Code 会话记录从一个账户迁移到另一个账户，迁移方式灵活，支持菜单栏图形界面和命令行 CLI 两种形式。核心特性包括零拷贝迁移——会话的 transcripts 和 sidecars 保留在原磁盘位置，session ID 不变，不复制任何数据；运行中的会话会被挂起直到用户批准重启，或选择"Move only the rest"跳过；同时支持云端 Remote Control 的会话协调，并且整个迁移操作可通过 undo 命令完整撤销。该工具使用 Node 22+，菜单栏版本还需 Xcode 命令行工具，已通过 56 次提交，包含完整测试用例和 CI 工作流。典型适用场景为同时拥有多个 Claude 账户（如工作、个人、测试等）的开发者在 macOS 上无缝迁移会话历史，避免重复查找过往对话记录。
items.quote: 将本地 Desktop 会话记录移动到另一个账号。脚本和附属文件保留在磁盘上，会话保留其 id，不会复制任何内容。

items.title: Show HN: Octoweb – a free, open-source keyboard-first browser for macOS
items.desc: description: Free, open source browser for macOS. Command palette, AI sidebar over ACP, and a builtin MCP server your agents can drive. WebKit and Rust, no Electron. title: Octoweb — the keyboardfirst AI browser for Mac image: https://octoweb.xyz/ogimage.png [ Free · Open source · Apache 2.0](https://github.com/muvon/octoweb) The browser you reach for when you want to think. Octoweb is a keyboardfirst AI browser for macOS. WebKit and Rust — no Electron, no Chrome, no mouse required. The command palette is the whole interface, the AI lives in a sidebar instead of a tab, and your agents can drive the browser directly over MCP. brew install cask muvon/tap/octoweb Copy [Download for Mac 0.14.0](https://github.com/Muvon/octoweb/releases/download/0.14.0/Octoweb0.14.0aarch64appledarwin.tar.gz) [View source](https://github.com/muvon/octoweb) Apple Silicon · macOS 13+ · No account required · [Intel Mac](https://github.com/Muvon/octoweb/releases/download/0.14.0/Octoweb0.14.0x86%5F64appledarwin.tar.gz) octoweb.xyz rust own TAB Rust ownership — the book doc.rustlang.org ⌘1 TAB octoweb — MCP server tools github.com ⌘2 HISTORY WKWebView content rules developer.apple.com ⌘3 ↵ Open ⌘↵ Navigate ⌘⇧↵ Ask AI 12345 ⌘⇧1–0 to pin · ⌘1–9 to jump ⌘⇧P One palette, everything Type a URL, a search, or any fragment of a page title you have seen before. Open tabs and history are fuzzymatched together and ranked by match quality and how often you actually go back. ⌘1–⌘9 Ten pages, one keystroke away Pin the docs you live in to a numbered slot with ⌘⇧1–0 and land back on them from anywhere. Slots survive restarts and show up in the footer bar and the newtab page. ⌃N ⌃P ⌃D ⌃U Your shell muscle memory works here Tab cycling in mostrecentlyused order, halfpage scrolls, ⌃A and ⌃E in every input, ⌃R to search prompt history. Nothing to learn if you already live in a terminal. ⌘, Every binding is yours Remap anything in Settings. Changes persist to keybindings.json and take effect on the very next keystroke — no restart, no reload, no config reload dance. [See all keyboard shortcuts →](/shortcuts) [ Powered by octomind.run](https://octomind.run) Powered by a local agent, not a hosted endpoint The sidebar speaks [ACP](https://agentclientprotocol.com) to an [octomind](https://octomind.run) agent running on your Mac. octomind fetches the agent manifest — model, system prompt, tools — from the community tap registry and configures itself. The browser never calls a model provider directly. 1 Install octomind curl fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/muvon/octomind/master/install.sh bash Copy 2 Start it in ACP mode octomind acp octoweb:assistant Copy 3 Press ⌘⇧A in Octoweb The sidebar connects on its own. Swap the agent tag in the header at any time — developer:rust, octoweb:trend, or one of your own. Inline edit (⌘⇧E) — select text on any page and rewrite, summarize, or translate it in place. Agentrendered UI — via render_ui agents draw real forms, buttons, and live views inline in the chat. Full [A2UI v1.0](https://a2ui.org/specification/v1.0a2ui/) basic catalog, with data binding and validation. Proactive learning — a background agent looks at your tabs and history every 30 minutes and memorizes patterns locally. On by default, one toggle to stop it. octoweb:assistant streaming Summarize this RFC and flag anything that breaks our client. Three changes matter for you: A2UI · approval card Open diff Dismiss Ask about this page… ↵ MCP client → localhost:3434/mcp → WKWebView An extension can read a page and paste text back. An MCP server can navigate, click, type, submit forms, screenshot, and read the console and network log. Octoweb keeps the agent out of your way while it works: browser_navigate always opens in the background, and browser_switch_tab is the only tool allowed to move your focus. One server covers every workspace. Requests carry an XOctowebWorkspace token that decides which workspace they act on, so an agent driving tabs in a background workspace never disturbs the one in front of you. Nothing to install, nothing to start The server comes up with the browser. Any MCP client takes the same URL — here is Claude Code: claude mcp add transport http octoweb http://localhost:3434/mcp Copy [Config for Claude Desktop, octomind, and anything else →](/mcp) A few of the 29 browser_click Click an element, retrying until stable and unobstructed browser_fill_form Fill several fields and optionally submit, in one call browser_execute_js Run JavaScript in the page — promises are awaited browser_snapshot Map interactive elements with @N refs — pierces iframes and shadow DOM browser_network_requests Recent fetch and XHR activity with statuses and timings render_ui Draw an interactive A2UI surface in the sidebar and wait for the click [Full tool reference →](/mcp) SSO session, staging cookies Isolated WKWebsiteDataStore Agentdriven, no login Isolated WKWebsiteDataStore Separate data store Isolated WKWebsiteDataStore Two accounts on the same site stay signed in at the same time. Log an agent into a scratch workspace and your real session is untouched. Rendering System WKWebView via wry — the same engine as Safari, kept current by macOS updates. Runtime Rust, LTO, stripped One binary. codegenunits = 1, no bundled Chromium, no Node process. Hotkeys CGEventTap Systemwide shortcuts straight from the OS event stream. Blocking WKContentRuleList Tracker and ad rules compiled inside WebKit, not run as page JavaScript. Cold start Zero network calls Favicons are cached as base64 data URIs, so startup never waits on a request. Memory Smart hibernation Background tabs freeze under pressure and thaw on return. Configurable keybindings ⌘, Remap any shortcut in Settings. Changes apply on the very next keystroke — no restart, no reload. Inline AI edit ⌘⇧E Select text on any page and transform it in place. Rewrite, summarize, translate — the result goes straight back into the field. Find in page ⌘F Fulltext search with native highlighting via the CS
items.author: donk8r
items.descZh: Octoweb 是一款专为 macOS 设计的免费开源键盘优先 AI 浏览器，基于 WebKit 和 Rust 构建（无 Electron、无 Chrome、无 Node 进程），采用单一精简二进制文件，并随 macOS 系统更新保持渲染引擎同步。它将命令行面板作为核心界面，配合模糊匹配的 URL/历史搜索、⌘1–9 编号固定常用页面、终端风格快捷键（⌃N/P/D/U/R）以及即时热重载的可重映射键绑定，实现全程无需鼠标的浏览体验。AI 功能通过 ACP 协议连接本地 octomind 智能体侧边栏（而非托管端点），支持内联编辑（⌘⇧E）、A2UI 智能体渲染 UI，以及每 30 分钟一次的本地主动学习模式。内置 MCP 服务器（localhost:3434/mcp）允许智能体直接驱动浏览器，工具集涵盖 29 项能力如 browser_navigate、browser_click、browser_snapshot 和 render_ui，并支持多工作区隔离（X-Octoweb-Workspace token）防止后台操作干扰前台会话。该浏览器面向键盘重度用户、终端开发者和 AI 智能体编排场景，需 Apple Silicon、macOS 13+，无账号要求，可通过 brew install cask muvon/tap/octoweb 安装，当前版本 0.14.0。系统级事件通过 CGEventTap 捕获，追踪与广告规则在 WebKit 层编译拦截而非注入页面 JS，配合智能休眠机制实现零网络冷启动和低内存占用。
items.quote: MCP 服务器可以执行导航、点击、输入、提交表单、截图等操作，并能够读取控制台日志与网络日志。

items.author: SouravInsights
items.descZh: webmcpstack 是一个面向 WebMCP 协议的开源开发者工具栈，定位为"在浏览器中让网站向 AI 智能体暴露类型化工具调用能力"的工程化中间层。其核心功能是 codegen 工具包(@webmcpstack/codegen)，可直接读取已有的 OpenAPI 契约并自动生成类型安全、经过人工审查的 WebMCP tool 集成代码，取代逐个手写 registerTool() 的繁琐流程，零安装零配置，通过 npx 一行命令即可运行。该项目的关键亮点在于强调"非简单的 API→WebMCP 转换器"——它解决了将应用动作安全暴露给 AI 智能体时涉及的安全、控制、可观测、可测试等治理问题，仓库已有 121 次提交、6 star、2 fork，并已发布到 npm 公共仓库及配套文档站。仓库结构采用 pnpm monorepo + turbo 构建，包含 codegen 核心包、openapipetstore 示例、完整 docs/brand 站点以及 .changeset/AGENTS.md 等工程化文件，暗示其正在向"生成 → 理解 → 审查 → 测试 → 控制 → 观测 → 安全"的完整产品闭环演进。适用场景主要是前端团队希望为自家 Web 应用接入 AI Agent 能力、又不想牺牲类型安全和运行时可控性的开发者。该项目仍处于早期阶段(目前仅 codegen 模块正式发布，未来计划支持更多契约来源与运行时管控层)。
items.quote: 这并不是一个简单的 API → WebMCP 转换器。它让智能体能够访问应用程序的操作。

items.descZh: 4D Chess 是基于经典国际象棋的四维变体游戏，将棋盘从传统的 8×8 扩展为 4×4×2×2 的超立方体（即 64 个方格分布在四个维度上），玩家通过四个坐标（X/Y/Z/W）控制棋子移动。核心玩法保留了车、王、后、象、马等棋子，但重新定义了它们的移动规则：车改变一个坐标、象同时改变两个相同步数的坐标、王可沿任意坐标组合移动一步、马则在 X 或 Y 上跳两格并在另一轴上跳一格，同时取消了王车易位、吃过路兵和兵的二连步等传统规则。平台提供免费的在线对战、人机对弈（四个 AI 难度，最高级搜索四层深度）、Glicko2 评级系统、谜题训练、小时赛制锦标赛以及可视化分析棋盘，无需注册账号即可使用，每日约有百局对局在线进行。该游戏适合国际象棋爱好者、数学/几何思维爱好者以及对高维空间概念感兴趣的玩家，也适合作为教学工具帮助理解四维坐标系与超立方体的直观概念。
items.quote: 四块棋盘构成一个超立方体。车从一块棋盘滑到下一块棋盘的同一格；你的王可能被另一个立方体中的棋子将军。

The DPI metadata is rewritten losslessly on your device: pixels are untouched, quality is identical, and nothing is uploaded. What is DPI — and why it doesn't change your pixels DPI (dots per inch) is a single metadata value that tells printers how densely to place your image's pixels on paper. A 3000×2000 px photo contains exactly the same pixels at 72 DPI and at 300 DPI — the only difference is the intended print size: 41.7×27.8 inches versus 10×6.7 inches. That's why this image DPI converter never reencodes your picture. It rewrites the resolution fields (JFIF & EXIF for JPG, the pHYs chunk for PNG) and leaves every pixel byte exactly as it was. Print shops and photo labs, academic journals and conference papers, Amazon KDP book covers and interiors, Etsy printables, embroidery and engraving services, passport and ID photo requirements, magazine ads — all of them routinely reject files whose DPI metadata isn't set to 300\. Fixing it takes seconds here and costs nothing. AI image creators are the newest addition to that list. Images generated by ChatGPT, Midjourney, DALLE, Stable Diffusion and Google Gemini are typically saved at 72 DPI — fine for screens, but rejected by every print workflow that checks the tag. The pixels are usually large enough (1024×1024 or bigger); only the density label is wrong. Drop the AIgenerated image here, set 300 DPI, and the file is printready without any upscaling or quality loss. Common image DPI requirements at a glance Different platforms and print services ask for different resolution settings. These are the values you will most often be asked for: Use case Required DPI Notes Amazon KDP covers & interiors 300 DPI Files below 300 DPI trigger printquality warnings Academic journals & papers 300–600 DPI Line art and charts often need 600 DPI Etsy printables & wall art 300 DPI Buyers expect crisp prints up to A4 and beyond US passport photo (2 × 2 in) 300 DPI 600 × 600 px at 300 DPI meets the official spec Magazine & newspaper ads 300 DPI CMYK delivery is usually requested as well Largeformat posters & banners 150 DPI Viewed from a distance, so lower density is fine Web & social media 72–96 DPI Screens ignore DPI — only pixel dimensions matter When a submission form rejects your file for "low resolution", it is almost always this single metadata number — change the image DPI to the required value above and reupload the very same picture. Why print services reject files over one number The rejection email rarely explains itself, so here is what actually happens on the other side, in the three places people hit it most: At the print shop. Commercial printers run every order through preflight software before a human ever sees it. That software reads one field — the DPI metadata — to decide how large your file will print. 核心功能是通过简单的物理动作或触发方式为用户打开应用程序，操作极为直观。

适用场景为追求高效工作流、桌面环境整洁的 macOS 重度用户，以及喜欢新奇桌面外设的工具控。
整体而言，Slicky 将冷冰冰的桌面机器人变成日常应用启动的趣味小助手。
